heading: 2.5 Compile-time arithmetic
text:
### 2.5 Compile-time arithmetic [LUNI.2.5]

| Op | Rule |
|---|---|
| `a/b + c/d` | `(ad+bc) / bd`, reduced |
| `a/b * c/d` | `ac / bd`, reduced |
| `a/b / c/d` | `ad / bc`, reduced — error if c=0 |
| `(a/b) ** n` (Int n ≥ 0) | `aⁿ / bⁿ` |
| `-(a/b)` | `(-a) / b` |
